name: Sovereign Frost
description: Lay a touch of commanding frost on the target so the whole body obeys the cold and stiffens at once.

name: Crown Lance
description: Cast a crowned lance of ice that pierces every layer of guard in a straight line.

name: Unyielding Hoar
description: Clothe the body in a thick hoar that does not crack under blows aimed at one spot again and again.

name: Preserving Chill
description: Hold an ally's wound in a preserving cold so it cannot worsen while the body mends itself.

name: Pale Judgement
description: Seal the qi of a strong foe with a single clear note of cold so the foe cannot answer.

name: Frozen Law
description: Lay the law of stillness on an art in flight so that it stops and breaks apart.

name: Preserved Breath
description: Keep the last breath of a fallen ally held in cold within a short window so the breath can be called back.

name: Rimeform
description: Turn the whole body to fine frost and pass through a barrier or a blow and take shape again beyond it.

name: Frostborn Edict
description: School move: speak the edict of the canon over a wide ground so each foe in it is sealed and chilled where they stand.

name: Eternal Hoar
description: School move: cast a hoar over the caster and allies that shields them and slows any foe who comes near.

name: Silent Verdict
description: School move: strike once without a sound and leave the foe sealed in stillness to the heart.

name: Frostfall Annihilation
description: Bring frost down upon a whole region to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Hoarbound Stillness
description: Hold a field still for one breath so nothing in it moves or flows and no art is cast; a consequence event.
